Durable execution and AI workflow infrastructure

Inngest
=======

Inngest provides durable execution infrastructure for developers building background jobs, event-driven workflows and AI agents. Its SDK adds steps to existing application code that retry independently, pause for input and resume without restarting completed work. Developers can configure per-tenant concurrency, rate limits and throttling, then inspect and replay executions. **Inngest Insights** supports SQL queries over execution data, while Agent Evals adds scoring and experiments tied to agent outcomes. The platform supports local execution and **Inngest Cloud**, with application code deployed on servers or serverless infrastructure.
